                @* CityId *@
                <Field ColumnSize="ColumnSize.Is6.OnTablet.Is6.OnDesktop">

                        string elementId = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyName<ImsProjectDto>(x => x.CityId);

                                <ValidationError/>
                            </Addons>

                    </Field>

                        }
                        <FieldLabel For="@elementId">@elementLabel</FieldLabel>
<|editable_region_end|>

                        <PersianDatePicker ElementId="@elementId" TValue="DateTime" @bind-Value="model.StartDate">

                </Validation>

                            string elementLabel = AttributesHelper.GetDisplayNameValue<ImsProjectDto>(x => x.EndDate) ?? elementId;
                        }
                        <FieldLabel For="@elementId">@elementLabel</FieldLabel>
